decision: The upstream patch removes a modern deprecated scroll-strategy factory/provider and inlines its modern default-options factory, including module and export changes. Tagged16 legacy module used the scroll-strategy provider and legacy public-api exported the scroll token, but did not export legacy-named factory/provider aliases. The current addon retains a locally owned Overlay-based factory/provider and module provider and additionally exposes legacy-named factory/provider aliases; those aliases are current addon exports, not claimed as tagged16 exports. The legacy default-options token remains the public peer token with minimum-peer default values; no removed upstream factory is called, and no modern default factory is claimed as a legacy export.
